claims.quote: As soon as the Paris contract released the telelectroscope, it was delivered to public use, and was soon connected with the telephonic systems of the whole world.
claims.description: The telelectroscope, a device for seeing distant places over telephone lines (a form of live television or video calling), is released to the public and linked into the world's telephone networks.

claims.quote: The improved 'limitless-distance' telephone was presently introduced, and the daily doings of the globe made visible to everybody, and audibly discussible, too, by witnesses separated by any number of leagues.
claims.description: An unlimited-range telephone combined with the telelectroscope makes daily events anywhere on Earth visible and discussable by everyone, like a global live video network.

claims.quote: I resume by cable-telephone where I left off yesterday.
claims.description: A newspaper correspondent in Chicago files his report to London by transoceanic cable telephone.

claims.quote: he called up one corner of the globe after another, and looked upon its life, and studied its strange sights, and spoke with its people
claims.description: Through an international telephone exchange, a man uses the telelectroscope to watch and converse with people anywhere on the globe in real time.

claims.quote: by grace of this marvellous instrument he was almost as free as the birds of the air, although a prisoner under locks and bars
claims.description: Live worldwide video gives an imprisoned man near-freedom by letting him virtually visit distant places.

claims.quote: In my opinion, the day will never come when it will do a farthing's worth of real service for any human being.
claims.description: A skeptic declares that the telelectroscope will never be of any practical use to anyone.

claims.quote: The coronation of our new emperor--the Czar.
claims.description: The Russian Czar is crowned emperor in Peking, implying Russia has taken over China.

claims.quote: To-day, by a clipper of the Electric Line, and the latter's Electric Railway connections, arrived an envelope from Vienna, for Captain Clayton, containing an English farthing.
claims.description: Mail travels from Vienna to Chicago by electric-powered ocean clippers connected to electric railways.

claims.quote: for in America under the new paragraph added to the Constitution in 1889, second trials are not State affairs, but national, and must be tried by the most august body in the land--the Supreme Court of the United States.
claims.description: A constitutional amendment makes all retrials federal matters heard directly by the US Supreme Court.

claims.quote: In the end it was found impossible to ignore or get around the French precedent.
claims.description: The US Supreme Court adopts the French Dreyfus-case doctrine that court verdicts can never be revised, and has a man hanged for a murder that never happened.

claims.quote: He has heard that whoever stretches himself out on one of those rocks there and asks for a deathless life can have his wish.
claims.description: In the stage play under review, a man is granted endless life with undiminished youth by a desert spirit, and it becomes a curse.
